import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sales by product (bar chart)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 0].bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales)))
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(i, v + 0.5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by time of day (line chart)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('datetime')
axes[0, 1].plot(df_sorted['datetime'].dt.strftime('%H:%M'), df_sorted['total'], 
                marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='darkorange')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Time of Day')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by age group (bar chart)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 2].bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(age_sales)))
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
for i, v in enumerate(age_sales.values):
    axes[0, 2].text(i, v + 0.5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Product size distribution (pie chart)
size_dist = df['size'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].pie(size_dist.values, labels=size_dist.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=sns.color_palette("pastel", len(size_dist)), startangle=90)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Payment method distribution (bar chart)
payment_dist = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[1, 1].bar(payment_dist.index, payment_dist.values, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
for i, v in enumerate(payment_dist.values):
    axes[1, 1].text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11)

# 6. Quantity vs Price scatter plot
scatter = axes[1, 2].scatter(df['price'], df['quantity'], c=df['total'], 
                            cmap='viridis', s=150, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Price vs Quantity (colored by Total)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Price ($)')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Quantity')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[1, 2])
cbar.set_label('Total Amount ($)')

# Add product labels to scatter points
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    axes[1, 2].annotate(row['product'], (row['price'], row['quantity']), 
                       fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
